name: microduck
title: Microduck by Pollen Robotics (25 cm biped, 15 servos)
notes: Velocity limits are the trained ranges of the Microduck walking policies (vx +-0.4 m/s, vy +-0.3 m/s, vyaw +-1 rad/s).
achieved: measured speed / commanded speed for your walking policy. 1.0 until you calibrate it with `python -m flymotion calibrate`.
head_look: the head angles of "look left", "look up"... head_sign: flip a sign if the head turns the wrong way on your robot.

skills.kick_left: kick a ball with the left foot
skills.kick_right: kick a ball with the right foot
skills.ground_pick: bend down and pick something up from the ground
skills.sit_toggle: sit down, or stand up again if already sitting
